abort.already_configured: This Meridian login is already set up.
abort.login_expired: This sign-in has expired. Start again to get a new code.
abort.no_accounts: Meridian has no active electricity account for this email.

error.cannot_connect: Couldn't get an answer from Meridian. Wait a few minutes, then try again.
error.email_not_found: Meridian didn't accept that email. Use the email you sign in to MyMeridian with.
error.invalid_auth: Meridian didn't accept the sign-in. Close this window and start again to get a new code.
error.invalid_data: Meridian Energy couldn't read your account details from Meridian. Select Submit to try again; if it keeps failing, check HACS for an update.
error.otp_expired: That code has expired. Close this window and start again to get a new one.
error.otp_invalid: That code isn't right. Check the email and try again.
error.otp_not_found: Meridian didn't find that code; it may already have been used. Close this window and start again to get a new one.
error.otp_too_many_attempts: Too many tries. Close this window and start again to get a new code.
error.rate_limited: Meridian asked Meridian Energy to wait. Wait a while, then try again.
error.reauth_email_refused: Meridian didn't accept the email for this entry. If you now sign in to MyMeridian with a different email, remove Meridian Energy and add it again with that email.

user.title: Connect Meridian Energy
user.description: Enter the email you use for MyMeridian. Meridian will email you a six-digit code. No password needed.

otp.title: Enter your code
otp.description: Enter the six-digit code Meridian sent to {email}.

discovery_retry.title: Couldn't load your accounts
discovery_retry.description: You're signed in. Select Submit to try again. You won't need a new code.

reauth_confirm.title: Reconnect Meridian Energy
reauth_confirm.description: Meridian has ended the sign-in for {email}. Select Submit to get a new code.

create_entry.default: Meridian Energy is connected. It's now fetching your last 90 days of usage and cost in the background, which can take several minutes. Until then its sensors show as unavailable, and its statistics can't be added to the Energy dashboard yet.

invalid_auth.message: Meridian has ended the sign-in. Reconnect Meridian Energy to sign in again.

cannot_connect.message: Couldn't get an answer from Meridian ({detail}). Meridian Energy tries again automatically.

rate_limited.message: Meridian asked Meridian Energy to wait. It tries again automatically after the wait.

invalid_data.message: Meridian refused a request or sent an answer Meridian Energy can't read ({detail}). It tries again automatically; if this keeps happening, check HACS for an update.

no_accounts.message: Meridian lists no active electricity account for this login. Meridian Energy checks again automatically; if the account has closed, remove Meridian Energy.

entry_too_old.message: This Meridian Energy entry was set up by an earlier version. Remove Meridian Energy and add it again.

sync_failing.title: Meridian Energy isn't updating
sync_failing.description:
{reason}

This notice goes away by itself once an update works.
